- [List ServiceTemplates](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/listservicetemplates.md): Lists editable and published Service records, including inactive records. Filtering applies to top-level Service fields only.
- [Get a ServiceTemplate](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/getservicetemplate.md): Retrieves one editable or published Service record by UUID.
- [Create or update a ServiceTemplate](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/upsertservicetemplate.md): Creates or sparsely updates an editable Service record. Published-copy UUIDs and publishing fields are rejected.
- [Soft-delete a ServiceTemplate](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/deleteservicetemplate.md): Sets active=0. Deleting an editable row also soft-deletes its published copy via the existing Service postCommit cascade; deleting a published-copy UUID only deactivates that published row.
- [Create an Add-on Job Diary item](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/createaddondiaryitem.md): Creates an immutable plaintext item in a Job Diary, attributed to the authenticated Add-on. Add-ons cannot read, update, or delete Diary items through this endpoint.
- [List job email history](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/listemailmessages.md): Returns merged inbound and outbound email history for jobs in the account.
- [Get one job email record](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/getemailmessage.md): Returns a single job email record by UUID.
- [List inbox messages](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/listinboxmessages.md): Retrieves a paginated list of inbox messages with optional filtering
- [Get inbox message details](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/getinboxmessage.md): Retrieves detailed information about a specific inbox message including attachments and conversation history
- [Mark message as read](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/markinboxmessageasread.md): Marks an inbox message as read
- [Archive or unarchive message](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/archiveinboxmessage.md): Archives or unarchives an inbox message
- [Snooze or unsnooze message](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/snoozeinboxmessage.md): Snoozes a message until a specified date/time or unsnoozes it
- [Convert message to job](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/convertinboxmessagetojob.md): Converts an inbox message into a new job, optionally using a job template
- [Attach message to existing job](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/attachinboxmessagetojob.md): Attaches an inbox message to an existing job
- [Add note to message](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/addnotetoinboxmessage.md): Adds a note to an inbox message
- [Create a new inbox message](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/createinboxmessage.md): Creates a new inbox message that will appear in the inbox
- [Create add-on notifications](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/createnotification-1.md): Sends a notification from the calling add-on to each supplied staff recipient.
- [Search across multiple object types](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/generalsearch.md): Performs a text search across jobs, companies, and materials. Returns combined results sorted by relevance.
- [Search within a specific object type](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/objectsearch.md): Performs a text search within a specific object type. Supported types: job, company, material, knowledgearticle, attachment, formresponse, asset, materialbundle
- [Semantic search for jobs](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/jobembeddingsearch.md): Harness the power of advanced AI embeddings to revolutionise how you search through job data. This endpoint transforms your search query into high-dimensional vector embeddings, then intelligently…
- [List job SMS history](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/listsmsmessages.md): Returns merged inbound and outbound SMS history for jobs in the account.
- [Get one job SMS record](https://developer.servicem8.com/reference/getsmsmessage.md): Returns a single merged job SMS record by UUID.
